cases.input: Two classes carry different vote ratios and one holder owns 51 percent economically in one class.
cases.expect: Economic and aggregate vote shares are calculated separately using pinned class rights.

cases.input: Two issuers hold each other's classes.
cases.expect: The calculation uses a declared cycle convention and preserves unresolved cases.

cases.input: Voting rights change after an approved class amendment.
cases.expect: A new class version becomes effective while historical positions retain the prior version.

cases.input: A 51 percent economic interest is asserted to mean 51 percent of votes.
cases.expect: The inference is rejected without a vote-weighted calculation.

cases.input: A majority holder signs a contract without an effective mandate.
Meeting attendance is used to establish board appointment and voting eligibility.
A resolution adopted without quorum is silently marked valid.
cases.expect: The transition is rejected and the defective record is preserved.
